'''Moorjhone''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]]<ref name="Death Sentence 1" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], within the [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]] and was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of felinoid Moorjhoni.<ref name="EAOC" /> It was in a trinary [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. It was normally lit and heated by two of the three suns at a given time. Once every ten years, however, all three suns would rise on the same side of the planet, resulting in the [[Day of Three Suns]].<ref name="Death Sentence 1" />

==History==
It was the location of a mine operated by [[Rim Commercial Mining]], headed by a [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] named [[Ja'Boag]]. Upon his arrival, the inhabitants of the planet were cast from their homes in the caves and forced to live outside. This endangered their lives, as the Day of Three Suns was fast approaching; without cover, everyone and everything on the surface would burn.<ref name="Death Sentence 1" />

Moorjhone became the site of a [[Battle of Moorjhone|battle]] between [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] investigating Ja'Boag's connection to Maul. After the battle, a wounded Maul was recovered from the desert and was convinced to lead an army of these residents against Ja'Boag, so that they could return safely to their homes. His intent, however, was focused solely on killing Ja'Boag and rescuing his brother, Opress.<ref name="Death Sentence 1" />
